q1.sampleAnswer: Because they are high in calories and trans fats, and eating too many of them can have bad effects on our health.
q1.rubricZh: 要点：热量高、反式脂肪多；吃多了对健康有害。
q1.explanationZh: 看第一段：油炸食品热量和反式脂肪都很高，所以吃得多会伤害健康。回答时把“高热量、高反式脂肪”和“对健康不好”两层意思都写出来。

evidence.quote: Yet these foods are high in calories and trans fats
So eating a lot of them can have bad effects on your health.

keyPoints.descZh: 油炸食品热量高、含反式脂肪多
examples: high in calories and trans fats

q2.sampleAnswer: Deep frying adds a lot of calories.
q2.rubricZh: 要点：油炸会增加大量热量。
q2.explanationZh: 第二段第一句用 Unlike（与……不同）把油炸和其他烹饪方式作对比，不同之处就是油炸会增加很多热量。

evidence.quote: Unlike most other cooking methods, deep frying adds a lot of calories.

keyPoints.descZh: 油炸会增加大量热量（其他烹饪方式不会）

q3.sampleAnswer: They lose water and absorb fat.
q3.rubricZh: 要点：失去水分；吸收脂肪。
q3.explanationZh: 第二段后半句说，食物在热油里炸的时候会失去水分并吸收脂肪，直接照这两点回答即可。

evidence.quote: they lose water and absorb fat

q4.sampleAnswer: Because deep frying changes the chemical structure of fats, turning them into trans fats. / Because trans fats are formed when oils are heated to very high temperatures during deep frying.
q4.rubricZh: 要点（答出其一即可）：油炸改变脂肪化学结构，把它变成反式脂肪；或油被加热到很高温度时会形成反式脂肪。
q4.explanationZh: 第三段解释了原因：油炸会改变脂肪的化学结构，把它变成反式脂肪；油在高温下就会产生反式脂肪，所以油炸食品很可能含有反式脂肪。

evidence.quote: Deep frying also changes the chemical structure of fats. It turns them into trans fats.
Trans fats are formed when oils are heated to very high temperatures during cooking.

keyPoints.descZh: 油炸改变脂肪的化学结构，把它变成反式脂肪
examples: changes the chemical structure of fats

keyPoints.descZh: 油被加热到很高温度时会形成反式脂肪
examples: oils are heated to very high temperatures

q5.sampleAnswer: Trans fats are difficult for our bodies to break down and can cause many diseases, including heart disease, cancer and diabetes.
q5.rubricZh: 要点：身体难以分解；会引起心脏病、癌症、糖尿病等多种疾病。
q5.explanationZh: 第四段说反式脂肪很难被身体分解，还会引发心脏病、癌症和糖尿病等很多疾病。注意把原文的 your 换成题目里的 our。

evidence.quote: Trans fats are difficult for your body to break down
trans fats can cause many diseases, including heart disease, cancer and diabetes

keyPoints.descZh: 身体难以分解反式脂肪
examples: difficult for your body to break down

keyPoints.descZh: 会导致疾病（心脏病、癌症、糖尿病等）/对健康有害

q6.sampleAnswer: Yes, I will start eating fewer fried foods because now I already know they are harmful to my health. I don’t want to become fat and have lots of trans fats in my body.
q6.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：先表明态度（Yes/No），再给出至少一条理由，可结合文中“高热量、反式脂肪、致病”等信息。
q6.explanationZh: 这是观点题，没有唯一答案。先明确回答会不会少吃油炸食品，再用文章里学到的知识说明理由，比如油炸食品热量高、含反式脂肪、可能引发疾病。

evidence.quote: Therefore, we’d better eat fewer fried foods.

keyPoints.descZh: 明确表明态度（会 / 不会少吃油炸食品）
给出至少一条合理理由（可结合文中热量高、反式脂肪、致病等信息）
examples: because they are high in calories

q7.explanationZh: 空前有 was，空后有 by，这是被动语态 was + 过去分词，所以填 caused。句意：这起事故是飞行员失误造成的。

q8.explanationZh: its 后面要用名词；and 后的 frustrations 是复数，所以 difficult 要变成名词复数 difficulties。句意：每份工作都有它的困难和挫折。

q9.explanationZh: 空格在 The 和名词 seasons 之间，要用形容词修饰；“变化着的季节”表示正在进行的变化，用现在分词 changing。

q10.explanationZh: a useful 后面需要一个可数名词单数，add 的名词是 addition。a useful addition to... 意思是“对……有用的新成员”。

q11.explanationZh: such 和名词 food 之间要填形容词，taste 的形容词是 tasty（美味的）。句意：你能告诉我做出这么美味食物的诀窍吗？

q12.explanationZh: suffered 后面要接名词作宾语，lose 的名词是 loss；loss of memory 就是“失忆”。
q12.tipsZh: suffer loss of... 遭受……的丧失

q13.explanationZh: 原句主动语态，宾语 them 变成主语 They；时态是一般现在时，主语是复数，被动用 are + 过去分词 turned，into 保留：They are turned into trans fats by it.

q14.explanationZh: 画线的 trans fats 是物，用 What 提问；原句有系动词 are，疑问句把 are 提到主语 fried foods 前面：What are fried foods very likely to contain?

q15.explanationZh: 用形式主语 it 改写：It is difficult for sb. to do sth.（对某人来说做某事很难），真正的主语是后面的不定式，意思和原句一样。
q15.tipsZh: It is + adj. + for sb. + to do sth.

q16.explanationZh: we’d better 中的 ’d 是 had 的缩写；前面陈述部分是肯定的，反意疑问部分用否定，所以是 hadn’t we。
q16.tipsZh: had better 的反意疑问句用 hadn’t + 主语

q17.explanationZh: 用动名词短语 Eating too many deep-fried foods 作主语，谓语用 is very likely to do（很可能做某事），最后接 affect our health：Eating too many deep-fried foods is very likely to affect our health.
q17.tipsZh: be likely to do sth. 很可能做某事；动名词作主语时谓语用单数
